## Summary

Describe the action, preflight, execution, or documentation improvement.

## Use Case

Explain the host-app scenario this would support.

## Proposed API

Optional. If you have a concrete API shape in mind, include the smallest useful form.

For new action kinds, useful details include identifier, input shape, capability hints, permission
requirements, and execution behavior.

## Notes

ActionKit should stay focused on action models, permission preflight, and execution. Host-app UI,
shortcut registration, persistence, analytics, and product policy generally belong outside this
package.
